en: Dependent on a state without applied thought (*nasavitakkam dhammam*), a state without applied thought arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccayā*) … three.
Dependent on a state without sustained thought (*naavitakkam dhammam*), a state without sustained thought arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state both without applied thought and without sustained thought (*nasavitakkan-ca naavitakkan-ca dhammam*), a state without applied thought arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; ... pe ... in the case of the prenascence and repetition conditions, there are six; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, there are nine.
